title: TikTok Sample Management: How to Run a Sample Queue That Doesn't Double-Shipping the Same Creator
summary: Stop accidentally sending the same creator three free samples. A practical TikTok sample management playbook for queue, dedup, budget caps, and sample ROI.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### What is TikTok sample management?


TikTok sample management is the operating process that governs sample terms, request review, duplicate prevention, fulfillment tracking, and post-delivery evaluation of creator activity. Treat identity, eligibility, inventory, and follow-through as one workflow with a single owner, shared approval rules, and one record per creator to control sample costs and connect samples to revenue outcomes.


### Why does the same TikTok creator receive duplicate samples?


Duplicate samples happen when teams match creators by display name instead of TikTok handle and work from separate lists. One teammate records "Jess M," another records "@jessmakes," and both approve a package for the same person. Match every request, approval, and shipment against the creator's TikTok handle in one shared record.


### What sample types does TikTok Shop support?


TikTok Shop supports free samples and refundable samples. A free sample requires no purchase payment from the creator, while a refundable sample follows a purchase-and-refund arrangement with eligibility conditions tied to current platform rules. Document the terms before your offer goes live, and confirm current settings in TikTok Shop Seller University.


### Who should own sample management on a brand team?


One operational owner should manage the sample queue and creator records, with marketing defining creator fit, operations confirming stock and shipping, and finance reviewing cost limits. This structure prevents one teammate approving a sample while another ships a second package from a separate list.


### How do I prevent duplicate sample shipments at scale?


Prevent duplicates by recording and searching the creator's TikTok handle before approval, checking existing creator and shipment records, and updating request, approval, and shipment status in one shared queue before another teammate acts. Reacher runs sample requests as one queue with bulk rejection and weekly caps, keeping decisions consistent as recruitment scales.


### Should I separate sample inventory from bulk sale stock?


Yes, keep sample stock visible as a distinct inventory allocation even when it comes from the same product. Separating sample quantities from bulk-sale availability shows fulfillment staff exactly what is reserved and reduces approvals against unavailable stock.


### What is the difference between Open Collaboration and Target Collaboration samples?


Open Collaboration publishes a sample offer that creators can request through the collaboration setup, while Target Collaboration lets your brand invite selected creators directly. Open offers collect requests faster and demand active inventory oversight; Target invitations give you a deliberate creator-selection step but require accurate creator records.
